chinese: 早上好我叫鲍勃费特曼我是电脑技术人员
english: Good morning my name is Bob Fetterman I'm the computer technician
soundmark: /ɡʊd ˈmɔːrnɪŋ maɪ neɪm ɪz bɒb ˈfetərmən aɪm ðə kəmˈpjuːtər tekˈnɪʃən/

chinese: 我为阿尔法维修公司工作
我想你们办公室有人打电话到我们总部我是被指派处理你的案例的工程师
english: I imagine someone from your office called our central office and I'm the engineer designated to your case

chinese: 抱歉但我不负责安排所有后勤工作

chinese: 我只能告诉你我这周接到电话就尽快赶来了
english: All I can tell you is I got the call this week and came as soon as I could

chinese: 我们尽力快速响应但有时会有超出我们控制的延误
english: We do our best to respond promptly but sometimes there are delays beyond our control
